# HomesByChuk

> HomesByChuk.com is the home buying and selling practice of Alexander "Chuk" Babenchuk, REALTOR® with LoKation Real Estate (FL Lic. SL3596634), serving West Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens and Jupiter, Florida. Sister site to RentalsByChuk.com (rentals only).

Contact: text or call (561) 220-9399 · chuk@homesbychuk.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://homesbychuk.com/): buyer/seller type picker, what Chuk handles, FAQ
- [Buy](https://homesbychuk.com/buy): buying process and pre-offer checks (flood/insurance, HOA documents, roof/4-point, commute & schools)
- [Sell](https://homesbychuk.com/sell): selling process and free pricing opinion request
- [Payment calculator](https://homesbychuk.com/calculator): monthly payment incl. tax, insurance and HOA
- [Communities](https://homesbychuk.com/communities): 12 neighborhoods across the three cities
- [About](https://homesbychuk.com/about): about Chuk

## Notes
- No market statistics are published on this site; ask Chuk for current pricing.
- For rentals, see https://rentalsbychuk.com
